documents.title: Issuance Of The Weblink Letter To Shareholders Under Regulation 36(1)(B) Of SEBI (Listing Obligation And Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
Notice For Convening The 33Rd Annual General Meeting Of The Company For The FY Ended On March 31, 2026.

analysis.summary: Mayur Uniquoters reported a 20% increase in standalone revenue for Q1 FY27, with management highlighting strong export performance and a focus on becoming a preferred supplier for overseas OEMs. While the company faces volatility in raw material prices and elevated freight costs, it maintains a positive outlook for the next 2-3 years. Management is currently evaluating potential international expansion sites while proceeding with a capacity expansion at their existing facility. The company aims to maintain its current margin levels and expects a top-line growth of 10% to 15% annually over the next three years. Mayur Uniquoters reported a 22% increase in standalone revenue for Q4 FY26, with PBT and PAT growing by 70% and 73% respectively.

guidance.claim: Management aims to maintain the current margin levels.
guidance.quote: And definitely, we will try to maintain the margin, which we have given you in our previous quarters and this quarter.

guidance.claim: The company expects domestic growth of 8%-10% and export growth of 15%-20% for the coming years.
guidance.quote: So, we have said in the last phone call also, our expectation from domestic growth is between 8%-10%. And our expectation from export growth is from 15%-20%.

guidance.claim: Management expects to maintain EBITDA margins in the 25%-30% range.
guidance.quote: So, we should look at somewhere around 25%-30% margin.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting a 15% growth in value for the coming year.
guidance.quote: So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

guidance.claim: Management expects the current growth momentum to continue for the next 2 to 3 years.
guidance.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects the current sales growth momentum to continue for the next 2 to 3 years.
demand_outlook.quote: And this sales growth and increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: Export growth momentum is expected to continue for the next 2-3 years.
demand_outlook.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2-3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is targeting higher-value items rather than low-priced products in the domestic market.
demand_outlook.quote: And in the domestic industry also, what type of business that we are targeting, we are not targeting a very low-priced item. We are targeting a much more higher-value items.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects export market growth to outpace domestic market growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Our concentration towards our export business is much more and our growth in the export market will be higher than the growth in the domestic market.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the European automotive industry is currently experiencing a period of degrowth.
demand_outlook.quote: But if you see, European automotive industry is not growing as much rather than it's -- there is a story of degrowth over there.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is adding a new production line at its existing facility with a capacity of 5 lakh meters, expected to be operational by February or March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027. So we'll have an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is still analyzing a global location for a potential INR 300 crore investment.
capex_expansion.quote: So, that analysis is going on. Whenever we are clear about that location, we will update you. But the CAPEX would be around INR 300 Cr for a global location.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is evaluating a potential capex of INR 200 crores for a plant in South India or INR 300 crores for a global plant.
capex_expansion.quote: So if we are evaluating which one we have to go for first. But if we do in South, it's approximately INR200 crores. If we do on a global scale, it will be INR300 crores over there.

capex_expansion.claim: A new plant would take approximately 2 years to start once a final decision is made.
capex_expansion.quote: So once the decision is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start.

margins_costs.claim: The company experienced margin pressure due to elevated freight costs and raw material price volatility.
margins_costs.quote: Some shipping cost, I already told you, shipping cost increased in this last quarter, 4x, okay, for the export and some traveling cost and other service cost, legal and professionals, etcetera, which we have incurred on that account.

margins_costs.claim: Management considers the current quarter's margin to be sustainable.
margins_costs.quote: But this present quarter's margin will be sustainable and expected to continue.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices have softened from March highs and availability is not currently an issue.
margins_costs.quote: And prices have also softened a little bit from the highs of March. It's softened a little bit. But availability is not an issue right now.

margins_costs.claim: Management believes they can maintain or slightly improve current EBITDA margins due to the product mix shifting toward exports.
margins_costs.quote: So therefore, the margin will be not less than today, it will be slightly better than today.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices for plasticizers and yarn have started to increase.
margins_costs.quote: In fact, plasticizers prices have started going up. Yarn prices have started going up.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is currently operating at 75% to 78% capacity utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are utilizing somewhere between 75% to 78%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has received new OEM supply orders from the U.S.A.
orders_capacity.quote: And in this context, we have received some good OEM supply orders from U.S.A., which have already started making good contribution to our export sales revenue and overall business profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: The company added more platforms for Ford business which is expected to increase in coming months.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we have added more platforms on Ford business. The business has started increasing. But it will increase more in the coming months.

orders_capacity.claim: The new coating line is expected to increase monthly capacity by approximately 5 lakh meters.
orders_capacity.quote: Generally average is 5 lakh meter monthly. It is rough calculation, it could be 4 and 6 too, but average will be that.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved a total volume of 76.3 lakh meters for the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Total volume has been 76.3 lakh meters, including PU, which has been 2.56 lakh meters for the quarter and value 6.17.

capital_allocation.claim: Management has not yet taken a final decision regarding a potential share buyback.
capital_allocation.quote: So for buyback, we have not taken the call. So I don't want to -- we will discuss and we'll let you know with – we have taken any final decision.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management identified market volatility, geopolitical conflicts, and shipping disruptions as key risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: See what is happening in the world since the last years. Covid has come. Ukraine war. Okay, then there was the West Asia war. Shipping lines disturbance has become very high.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces intense competition from China in the PU segment.
risks_headwinds.quote: PU, there is a lot of intense competition from China for sure.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces short-term margin pressure when raw material prices rise because it takes time to pass costs to customers.
risks_headwinds.quote: Short-term, yes, maybe a month or so. Because it takes some time to pass on the price increase to the customers. Definitely, it impacts a little bit in the short-term.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company is not currently impacted by the tariffs imposed by the Mexican government.
risks_headwinds.quote: I can just tell you in brief right now, we are not impacted right now.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the footwear business is facing pressure due to local competition and low price margins.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our Footwear business is not growing because of local competition, because of price -- low price margin.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to commission an additional production line at its existing facility.
management_commitments.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: The new coating line is expected to be commissioned by the end of the calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: We have already ordered for an existing location. So, by the end of this calendar year, it should be done.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve 15% growth in value for the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: Sir, I have told you to go up by 15% on average and calculate the margin saving, then you will get a clear idea.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
